name: Coordinate crop · single final image
hypothesis: Use Step 1 water-mask coordinates to select a lower-water crop directly on the original photo, then create only the final 224 × 224 regressor image. This should remove full-resolution mask expansion, Step 1 image materialization, the intermediate JPEG round trip, and Step 2 segmentation.
changes: Keep Step 1 segmentation on the full photo resized to 448 × 448.
Downsample only the predicted mask to 224 × 224 and select the lower-water rectangle.
Map selected mask coordinates to the original photo and resample that source ROI directly into the final 224 × 224 canvas.
Apply the selected water mask at final-image resolution; omit the Step 1 intermediate image and Step 2 segmentation.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression
